close_reason: fixed: MemoryBackend create_object now sets size from serialized JSON byte length instead of leaving placeholder 0; email.rs has explicit backend-contract comment; integration test email_set_create_size_is_nonzero asserts size>0
description: email.rs build_email_from_create sets size=0 as a placeholder and documents that the backend must set the real value. The MemoryBackend create_object does NOT update size — it stores 0. When Email/set create returns the email object with server-set fields, it echoes back created_obj.size which is 0. RFC 8621 §5.5.3 says size is server-set; if a client reads size from the Email/set response it will see 0. Any test that asserts size > 0 after Email/set create will fail; currently there may be no such test, giving false confidence. Maintenance consequence: the 0-size contract fossilizes as implicit behaviour before it is caught.
title: Email/set create: size=0 placeholder may fossilize as a public API assumption
